visualSpecExcerpt:
=== HOME PAGE SPEC (viewport 390x844, iOS) ===
[LAYOUT]
status-bar: top 0, height 54px (9:41 + icons), Dynamic Island pill center
header: flex row, padding 16px 20px, items center, gap 12px
  hamburger: svg 24px #1A1A1A
  greeting-col: flex 1; line1 'Hi Taban 🙌' 20px 700 #1A1A1A; line2 'Good Morning!!' 13px 400 #9E9E9E
  avatar: img 44x44 border-radius 50% (assets/avatar-taban.jpg), border 2px #FFFFFF, box-shadow
  search: svg 24px #1A1A1A
category-row: flex row, gap 10px, padding 12px 20px, overflow-x auto
  pill 'All': height 36px, padding 0 18px, border-radius 20px, bg #1A1A1A, color #FFFFFF, 14px 500
  pill 'Cat'/'Dog'/'Bird': same shape, bg #FFFFFF, border 1px #E0E0E0, color #1A1A1A
featured-section: padding 16px 20px
  cards-row: flex row, gap 16px, justify center
    card-left: width 150px, flex col items center
      circle: 150x150, border-radius 50%, bg #FF8A80, overflow hidden; img assets/dog-familiar.jpg object-fit cover, centered, width 120px height 120px border-radius 50%
      label: 'Familiar Dog' 14px 600 #1A1A1A margin-top 8px
      sub: 'Half white Color' 12px #9E9E9E
      price: '$140.00' 16px 700 #1A1A1A margin-top 4px
    card-right: same shape; img assets/dog-soft.jpg; 'Soft Dog' / 'White Color' / '$241.99'
  see-more: flex row centered, margin-top 16px; pill 'See more' with paw svg 16px #C2185B, 13px 500 #C2185B
expensive-section: padding 16px 20px
  header-row: flex row justify between items center
    title: 'Expensive Cat' 18px 700 #1A1A1A
    link: 'See All' 14px 600 #C2185B
  cards-row: flex row, gap 12px, margin-top 12px
    cat-card: width 140px, border-radius 16px, bg #FFFFFF, box-shadow 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), overflow hidden
      img: assets/cat-1.jpg width 140px height 110px object-fit cover
      body: padding 8px 10px; row flex justify between; col: 'Persian Cat' 13px 600 #1A1A1A, '$320.00' 12px 700 #1A1A1A; heart svg 18px #E53935
    cat-card2: same with assets/cat-2.jpg
likes-chip: absolute/fixed bottom 96px right 20px; pill, bg #FFFFFF, box-shadow 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), padding 8px 14px, border-radius 20px; heart svg 16px #E53935 + '1,327' 13px 600 #1A1A1A
bottom-nav: fixed bottom 0, width 100%, height 64px, bg #FFFFFF, border-top 1px #E0E0E0, flex row justify around items center
  home: svg 24px #9E9E9E
  heart: svg 26px #C2185B (active, centered)
  profile: svg 24px #9E9E9E
[COLORS]
primary: #C2185B
paw-red: #E53935
card-coral: #FF8A80
selected-pill: #1A1A1A
border: #E0E0E0
muted: #9E9E9E
text: #1A1A1A
[SHADOWS]
card-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
float-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)
[RADII]
circle: 50%
cat-card: 16px
likes-chip: 20px
=== END SPEC ===
